answer: Each agent bonds stake before joining an epoch and proves Semaphore-tree membership while evaluating the epoch polynomial that encodes its RLN identity. Messages carry zero-knowledge proofs and rate-limit commitments; exceeding the limit yields Shamir shares that let anyone reconstruct the signer’s private key. The contract verifies the evidence and instantly slashes the bond, deterring Sybil identities. Onyx, haven, and delta designate separate epochs.
